prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: BACKGROUND ONLY for a cozy small-screen campus pet game. Landscape composition, approximately 3:2. Professional softly painted gouache storybook game environment, simplified inviting shapes, delicate painted texture, muted university slate blue, pale sage, chalk-white walls and warm light wood; atmospheric and calm, consistent art direction. A believable miniature student space inspired by BUPT Shahe campus, interpreted as fiction rather than an architectural reconstruction. No cats, no people, no animals, no characters, no UI, no frame, no labels, no logos, no text, no lettering. The actual pet will be overlaid in code: leave a clear softly lit FLOOR landing area in the lower-right, covering horizontal 58-90% and vertical 45-83% of the frame. Put most distinctive furniture and props on the left and in the upper half. View from a slightly raised three-quarter front angle, gentle perspective, restrained detail readable at only 354x216 pixels. Broad quiet spaces rather than tiny clutter. No dramatic depth of field. Opaque painted background. Scene: a warmly lived-in Chinese university dormitory nook. On the left a compact light-wood bed with a neatly folded pale sage quilt and cream pillow, a small bedside shelf with books and a little potted plant. Upper-left a student desk with a closed notebook and a soft blue reading lamp. A generous window in the rear shows autumn trees and a distant glimpse of a modern curved campus library facade with vertical white fins and glass. Warm afternoon light across light oak flooring. The lower-right foreground must remain open floor for the small cat sprite; do not place furniture there. Cozy student home, no luxury hotel or generic cartoon palace.
